description: Expected numerical outputs for causal_regimes paper reproducibility

hmm_primary_fit.description: Primary HMM fit: Student-t, K=3 regimes, seed=28, full sample 1990-2024

log_likelihood.notes: EM algorithm convergence may vary slightly

bic.formula: -2*LL + k*log(n), where k=92 parameters (mu:18 + Sigma:63 + nu:3 + A:6 + pi:2)
bic.notes: Cluster 1 with seeds 28, 20, 6 (highest LL cluster, 0% GFC detection)

convergence.tolerance_notes: Different random seed or initialization may affect iteration count

granger_causality_lag1.description: Granger causality tests (HML→SMB) at lag=1, full sample by regime
granger_causality_lag1.methodology: Standard F-test + HAC Wald test with Andrews (1991) bandwidth

n_obs.notes: Boundary-clean observations where current and prior lag days in Normal regime

hac_p_value_andrews.notes: HAC Wald test with Andrews data-driven bandwidth

frozen_oos_validation.description: Frozen out-of-sample test: train HMM on 1990-2012, classify 2013-2024 using filtered (no-lookahead) probabilities

Normal.notes: Frozen OOS (trained 1990-2012, predicted 2013-2024): lowest mean norm

Crisis.notes: Frozen OOS: highest mean norm (1.905, very close to Elevated)

oos_elevated_hml_to_smb_lag1.description: Granger test on OOS Elevated regime only (HML→SMB at lag=1)

n_obs.notes: Boundary-clean observations in OOS Elevated regime (2013-2024, frozen HMM trained on 1990-2012)

f_stat.notes: F-test statistic for HML→SMB in OOS Elevated

f_p_value.significance: Not significant in this replication run; paper reports 0.014 with different regime assignment

hac_p_value_andrews.notes: HAC Wald test with Andrews bandwidth

structural_break_tests.description: Bai-Perron / Quandt-Andrews sup-F tests for structural breaks in Normal-regime HML→SMB coefficient
